 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Infer the repeating diagonal-stripe sequence from the given colored markers.
    by_offset = {}
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c, value in enumerate(row):
            if value:
                by_offset[c - r] = value

    period = 1
    for candidate in range(1, h + w + 1):
        if all(by_offset[a] == by_offset[b]
               for a in by_offset for b in by_offset
               if (a - b) % candidate == 0):
            period = candidate
            break

    phase = {offset % period: value for offset, value in by_offset.items()}
    return [[phase[(c - r) % period] for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
